app.title: Genesy Office
app.tagline: Back office: products, stock, batches, invoices and orders.

products.title: Products
products.name: Name
products.storeOnly: Sold at the till only (not in the web shop)
products.serverChecked: Prices and status are checked by the server when you save.
products.priceInclHint: Shown as {price} with VAT in the shop.
products.labelsHint: Shown as chips in the shop, up to 8. Separate them with commas.
products.vatNone: No VAT groups yet, so the workspace default applies.
products.vatFailed: VAT groups could not be loaded, so the workspace default applies.
products.sizesShopNote: Once a product has sizes, the shop sells only the sizes; the product on its own no longer shows there.
products.categoriesFailed: Categories could not be loaded, so the category stays as it is.
products.categoriesNone: No categories yet. Add them under Categories.

lots.title: Batches
lots.recallText: Batch {code} will show as recalled on its public page and on every jar's QR link.

statusText.released: Released batches can be sold and show their passport. A recall stops sales and puts a warning on the passport.
statusText.quarantine: Batches in quarantine are held back from sale until you release them.
statusText.recalled: This batch is recalled: its public page and every jar's QR link show a recall warning.

secret.once: Copy this secret now. It is shown only once.
secret.label: Secret

appKeys.title: App keys
appKeys.name: Name
appKeys.revokeText: Apps using this key stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
appKeys.intro: Keys let the web shop and the till talk to Genesy. Each account has its own.
appKeys.secretHint: Store it where the shop server can read it.

scopeHints.checkout_write: Place orders from the web shop
scopeHints.till_login: Let staff sign in at the till

appKeys.chooseKind: Choose what the key is for

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.deleteText: {url} will get no more events. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.intro: Webhooks tell your other systems when something changes in this account.
webhooks.secretHint: Use it to check that events really come from Genesy.

passport.title: Passport · {code}
passport.draftDiffers: The draft has changes that are not published.
passport.publishText: The saved draft becomes the public page for batch {code}. Anyone with the QR link sees it.
passport.unpublishText: The public page for batch {code} stops showing. QR links on jars will find nothing until you publish again.

done.published: Published: the public page shows this version.
done.unpublished: Taken offline: the public page no longer shows.

passport.draftDiffersTitle: Draft differs from the published passport
passport.draftDiffersBody: Customers still see v{version} until you publish.

stock.title: Stock
stock.negativeHint: Store rows sold below zero at the till. Count them and correct the stock.
stock.count: {total, plural, one {# stock row} other {# stock rows}}
stock.belowZeroWhy: More was sold here than was recorded. Count it and correct it.
stock.batchesApart: This changes the stock without a batch. Batches here are changed on their batch page:

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.unnumbered: Open the invoice without a number
invoices.nothingToDo: Nothing left to do on this invoice.
invoices.draftInfo: A draft gets its number when you send it.

next.send: Check the lines, then send it.
next.pay: Record a payment when the customer pays.
next.credit: Credit it to take lines back.
next.mark_as_credited: Mark it credited once the refund is paid.
next.resend: Send it to the customer again.
next.duplicate: Start a new draft from this one.

delivery.queued: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is queued.
delivery.accepted: Invoice numbered. The mail server accepted the email; delivery is unconfirmed.
delivery.manual: Invoice numbered. Deliver it to the customer manually; no email was sent.
delivery.blocked: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is blocked; check the mail settings.
delivery.failed: Invoice numbered. Email delivery failed; check its status before trying again.
delivery.unknown: Invoice numbered. Email delivery is uncertain; verify its status before trying again.
delivery.uncertain: The invoice may have changed. Delivery is unconfirmed; check its status before trying again.

invoices.emailUnavailable: Email sending isn't set up yet.
invoices.pdfUnavailable: PDFs aren't available on this server yet.
invoices.cancelText: It stays in the list as cancelled and never gets a number.

payBy.settle: A credit note of this customer

invoices.noCreditNotes: This customer has no open credit note.
invoices.voidText: It stays on record as voided and no longer counts.
invoices.creditDialogText: Makes a draft credit note. Send it to number it.
invoices.markText: Records the refund of the open amount and closes the credit note.
invoices.noContact: This customer has no contact person yet.
invoices.noAddress: This customer has no address yet.

orders.title: Orders
orders.pickText: Enter the total picked per line so far.
orders.completeText: The reserved stock is taken out of the warehouse. This cannot be undone.
orders.returnsText: Enter the quantity coming back per line. Leave a line empty if nothing comes back.
orders.restock: Put returned goods back on stock
orders.refundText: Money goes back to the customer through the payment provider. This cannot be undone.
orders.refundQueued: Refund of {amount} sent to the provider (status: {status}).
orders.cancelText: Reserved stock is released. A paid order needs a refund first; the system will say so.
orders.nothingToDo: Nothing more to do on this order.
orders.serverAmounts: Amounts as calculated by the server.

next.confirm: Confirm the order to reserve its stock.
next.pick: Record what has been picked so far.
next.complete: Complete the order to take its stock out of the warehouse.
next.invoice: Make an invoice for this order.
next.return: Take back goods the customer sent back.

orders.noCustomer: No customer details on this order.
orders.itemsUnits: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
orders.trailNote: Who did what is recorded from now on; older steps show their times only.

till.title: Till
till.deactivateText: They can no longer log in at the till and their open session ends.
till.onlyMismatch: Only sales with other prices than the catalog
till.unsellableValue: {count, plural, one {# line no longer for sale} other {# lines no longer for sale}}
till.pairHint: On the till, open setup and type the shop name and this code.
till.revokeText: The till stops at once and logs out. Pair it again with a new code to use it.

supply.title: Supply
supply.linksHint: Links let a partner's farm send batches here. The allow-list says which farmer details may show on your public batch pages; names and photos never do.
supply.acceptText: Batches can then be sent to this workspace. Your public batch pages may show: {fields}.
supply.revokeText: No more batches can be sent or received over it. Stock already received keeps crediting farmers. To resume, the partner must grant a new link.
supply.receiveText: {quantity} were sent. Receiving makes a new batch here and can be done only once; if less arrived, enter what arrived and the shortfall stays on record.

packing.title: Pack batch {code} into jars
packing.text: Makes a new batch of jars from this batch's kg. The kg leave this batch and the jars go into stock at once. Only a batch from a supply can be packed, once.

session.expired: Your session ended. Log in again to carry on.

states.notFoundText: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
states.capped: Showing the first {shown} of {total}. Search is not available here yet.
states.noAccess: You don't have access to this
states.noAccessText: Ask an admin of this account to give you access.
states.crashed: Something went wrong on this page.
states.crashedText: Try again. If it keeps happening, tell us what you were doing.
states.offlineText: Check your connection, then try again.

done.stockChanged: Stock changed; the movement is listed below.

lot.received: Transfer received into this new batch.

done.deactivated: {name} can no longer log in at the till.
done.activated: {name} can log in at the till again.
done.stockUnmoved: Nothing moved: the change was 0, or this product doesn't keep stock.

images.title: Images
images.hint: First image is the shop cover. Use the arrows to reorder.

credits.title: Farmer credits
credits.noGroups: The public page shows no farmer groups for this batch.
credits.empty: No sales or returns of this batch yet.

login.subtitle: Products, stock, orders, batches and the till — for your account.

overview.title: Overview
overview.recentOrdersSub: Web shop and office, newest first
overview.lotInQuarantineHint: Check it, then release or recall it
overview.belowZeroCount: {total, plural, one {# product below zero} other {# products below zero}}
overview.belowZeroHint: Count them and correct the stock
overview.mismatchCount: {total, plural, one {# till sale at other prices} other {# till sales at other prices}}
overview.tillNote: Counts come from the till lists; money totals stay on the shift pages.

search.title: Search
search.tooShort: Type at least 3 characters to search.

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Invite people by email to work in this account.
invites.newText: They get an email with a link to join this account.
invites.teamHint: The team decides what they may do.
invites.withdrawText: The link in their email stops working.

members.title: Members
members.intro: People who work in this account. Remove someone who left: their orders, invoices and history stay.
members.name: Name
members.removeText: They can no longer open this account and leave their teams. Their orders, invoices and history stay. Invite them again to give access back.

invite.title: Your invite
invite.invalid: This invite link is not valid
invite.passwordRule: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case, a number and a symbol.
invite.joinedHint: Log in again to open it.

lotStock.title: Change stock in {code}
lotStock.empty: No stock in this batch yet

lotErrors.stockInRecalled: This batch is recalled, so no stock can be added. You can still write stock off.
lotErrors.packRecalled: This batch is recalled, so it can't be packed.
lotErrors.packQuarantined: This batch is on hold, so it can't be packed. Release it first.
lotErrors.statusFinal: A recalled batch can't change status.
lotErrors.orderRecalled: A batch this order holds was recalled, and no other batch could take over. Cancel the order to free it.
lotErrors.orderQuarantined: A batch this order holds is on hold. Release the batch or cancel the order.
lotErrors.orderExpired: A batch this order holds has expired. Cancel the order to free it.

supplyWarn.recalled: The source batch was recalled by the supplier.
supplyWarn.quarantine: The source batch is on hold at the supplier.
supplyWarn.receiveHint: You can still receive it. Decide what to do with the stock: put your batch on hold or recall it.

lotHolds.title: Orders waiting on this batch
lotHolds.hint: No other batch at that warehouse could take these orders over. Cancel the order, or release this batch.

categories.title: Categories
categories.name: Name
categories.removeUsed: {count, plural, one {# product} other {# products}} will become uncategorised. The products themselves stay.

scheduled.title: Scheduled reports
scheduled.intro: Reports the voice assistant emails to you on a schedule. Only you get them.
scheduled.emptyHint: Ask the voice assistant, e.g. “Every Monday send me a sales summary”.
scheduled.deleteText: You stop getting this email. You can ask the assistant for a new one at any time.
scheduled.lostHint: You no longer have access to this report. Ask an admin, then resume it.
scheduled.onlyYou: Only you, at your login email

unsubscribe.title: Stop this report?
unsubscribe.text: You will no longer get this email. You can resume it later in Scheduled reports.
unsubscribe.done: Done: you will not get {report} emails any more.
unsubscribe.invalid: This link is not valid any more

corrections.stock: Raw lot stock changes by {kg} kg
corrections.owes: {name} will owe {amount} back. New payouts are blocked until later sales cover it.
corrections.fileText: Kg only. Another ops or admin must approve before anything changes. The farmer sees the correction in their passbook.

connection.title: Shop connection
connection.connectedHint: This workspace has its own Shop address. Share it with your customers.
connection.disconnectedHint: Connect this workspace to make its catalog and passport links available in Shop.
connection.disconnectText: The catalog and new checkout will become unavailable. Existing orders and payments remain available. Reconnecting keeps the same Shop address.
connection.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the Shop address above.
connection.addressUnavailable: The Shop address is unavailable. Contact your administrator.
connection.requiredHint: Connect this workspace in Settings → Storefront, or ask your administrator, before sharing passport links.

storefront.title: Storefront design
storefront.intro: Review saved revisions before publishing changes to your shop.
storefront.publishText: This revision will replace the published home page. The previous revision remains available to restore.
storefront.restoreTitle: Restore this revision as a draft?
storefront.restoreText: This creates a new draft. Your published shop stays unchanged until you publish it.
storefront.restoredDone: Revision restored as a new draft.
storefront.conflict: The storefront changed. Select a revision to refresh its preview and review it again.
storefront.unsupported: This revision cannot be previewed with the available components.

payments.title: Payments
payments.intro: Review online collections, refunds, settlements and chargebacks.
payments.reviewHint: The payment outcome is uncertain. Please wait for confirmation or contact the supplier. Do not pay again.
payments.qr: Scan this QR code to continue payment
payments.resolveHint: Use verified financial evidence only. This cannot mark a collection paid.
payments.refundReconciledHint: Verify that the provider's total refunded amount matches all locally confirmed refunds, with no external or pending refunds.
payments.attest: I verified this outcome against provider records and accept that this action is audited.
payments.settingsIntro: Configure online payments. Credentials stay on the server.
payments.productionBlocked: Production unavailable until the official provider origin is approved.
payments.identityHint: Merchant ID and username cannot change after use. Password rotation remains available.
payments.maskHint: Masked values keep existing credentials. Empty values request clearing; used credentials cannot be cleared.
payments.rotationHint: A new callback secret keeps the previous secret for callbacks already in flight. Retire it separately after verification.
payments.retireHint: Retirement stops accepting callbacks signed with the previous secret. Confirm provider rotation before continuing.
payments.refundSubmitted: Refund submitted. Check Payments for confirmation.
payments.refundHint: Refund a captured online payment against this credit note. Find its local payment ID on the original invoice or Payments page.
payments.exactAmount: Enter the exact decimal amount. The server checks currency precision and available balance.
payments.savedSetupHint: Saved settings for this deployment: {environment}. New online payments are unavailable until setup is complete. Missing saved fields:
payments.onlineUnavailableHint: Please use the bank details below or contact the supplier.
payments.deploymentRealmHint: Provider account settings belong to this deployment. Staging and production use separate deployments and data. The server selects the payment environment.
payments.setupUnavailableHint: The server has not supplied an allowed payment environment. Ask an administrator to check this deployment before saving settings.
payments.transactionHint: Provider records are not added together. The confirmed charge identifies the payment received; settlement is tracked separately.

imports.title: Imports
imports.intro: Bring products, customers and suppliers in from a spreadsheet. Every row is checked before anything is saved.
imports.emptyHint: Start with a .csv or .xlsx file of at most 500 rows.
imports.choose: Spreadsheet (.csv or .xlsx, at most 2 MB and 500 rows)
imports.mapHint: Pick which column fills each field. Columns you leave out are not imported.
imports.needMapping: Match at least one column first.
imports.needKey: Choose the column that holds the product's {key}.
imports.applying: Importing… this page updates by itself.
imports.invalidNote: {count} rows need a fix and will not be imported. Correct the file and start a new import for them.
imports.noValid: No row is ready to import. Correct the file and start a new import.
imports.failed: This import stopped before saving anything new. The person who started it may no longer have permission.
imports.rowsFailed: {count} rows could not be saved; see what to fix below.
imports.incomplete: This import was not fully checked. Start a new import with the same file.
imports.stale: This import changed since you opened it. We loaded the latest version; check it and try again.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.serverAmounts: Amounts as the server calculated them.
purchases.onlyDrafts: Only draft orders can be changed.
purchases.draftSupplier: The supplier's details are frozen when you confirm.
purchases.nothingToDo: Nothing left to do on this order.

next.update: Change the draft before you confirm it.
next.confirm: Check the order, then confirm it to the supplier.
next.book: Book the received goods into stock.

purchases.confirmText: After confirming, the lines and prices can no longer change.
purchases.receiveText: Enter what arrived. Leave a line empty when nothing came.
purchases.closeTitle: Close what is still open on PO-{number}
purchases.closeText: The supplier will not deliver these quantities. Goods already received stay bookable.
purchases.cancelText: Nothing has been received yet. Cancelling closes every open line.
purchases.bookText: Choose the lines to book. Add freight or other costs to spread over them.
purchases.lateWarning: Some lines arrived before stock that is already valued. Booking late lines comes in a later release.
purchases.landedCostsText: Freight, duties or handling to add to the stock value.
purchases.journal: Posts to inventory, against goods received not invoiced.
purchases.stockOnly: Stock only: accounting is not active yet, so no value is posted.
purchases.stale: This order changed since you opened it. We loaded the latest version: check it and try again.

reasons.stale_document: This order changed since you opened it. We loaded the latest version: check it and try again.
reasons.receipt_booking_required: Book the earlier receipt for this product and warehouse first.
reasons.backdated_valuation: This receipt is dated before stock that is already valued, so it cannot be booked yet.
reasons.accounting_period_closed: The accounting period for this date is closed.
reasons.accounting_not_configured: Accounting is not set up for this. Ask an admin to finish the accounting setup.
reasons.unsupported_active_erp_operation: Extra costs need active accounting. Book without them for now.

roles.provider_clearing: Card and mobile money in transit

reasons.stale_document: This changed since you opened it. We loaded the latest version: check it and try again.
reasons.accounting_not_configured: Accounting is not active yet. Posting starts once the book is set up and activated.
reasons.accounting_period_closed: No open period covers this date. Add or open a period for it first.
reasons.unsupported_active_erp_operation: This can't be changed here. Posted entries and an active setup stay as they are; correct them with a reversal.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add the first one to start the chart.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.newText: A code and name of your choice. The type decides where it shows in the reports.
accounts.editText: Rename the account or switch it off. An account used for a setup role stays in use.

periods.title: Fiscal years and periods
periods.rangeHint: The end date is the first day after the year or period.
periods.emptyYears: No fiscal years yet. Add one, then its periods.
periods.emptyPeriods: No periods in this year yet.
periods.newYearText: At most 24 months, never overlapping another year.
periods.newPeriodText: Inside an open fiscal year, never overlapping another period.

journals.title: Journals
journals.notActive: Accounting is not active yet. You can prepare drafts; posting starts once the book is activated.
journals.linesHint: Each line goes on one side: a debit or a credit. Debits and credits must be equal before posting.
journals.onlyDrafts: Only a draft can be changed. A posted journal is corrected with a reversal.

next.post: Check the entry, then post it to the book.
next.reverse: Made a mistake? A reversal books the opposite entry; the original stays.

journals.postedInfo: This journal is posted and can't be changed.

post.title: Post this journal
post.text: Check the amounts as they will be booked. Posted entries can't be changed.

reverse.title: Reverse {title}
reverse.text: Books the opposite entry on the date you choose. The original stays as it is.

reports.title: Reports
reports.pickAccount: Choose an account to see its ledger.
reports.empty: No posted entries in this range.
reports.balanceHint: Balances are shown as debit minus credit.
reports.currentEarnings: Profit not yet closed into equity

cash.title: Cash
cash.hint: Cash the book holds per till drawer and safe. A count that differs is fixed with a reviewed adjustment.
cash.empty: No cash places yet. Add a till register first.
cash.countText: Enter what you counted. We compare it with the book before anything is saved.
cash.noJournal: Accounting is not active yet: only the cash record changes, no journal is booked.

setup.title: Accounting setup
setup.setupInfo: The book is being set up. Choose its currency, timezone and the account for each role. Activation comes later with the opening balances.
setup.activeInfo: The book has been active since {at}. Its setup can no longer change.
setup.readOnly: You can view the setup. Changing it needs the accounting setup right.
setup.missing: {count, plural, one {# role still needs an account} other {# roles still need an account}}
setup.rolesHint: Genesy books each kind of business event to the account you pick here.

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.hint: The tax rules your sales and purchases are taxed by. A profile counts once it is verified.
taxes.correctText: A verified profile never changes. This draft becomes its next revision once verified.
taxes.scopeHint: Leave the region empty for the whole country.
taxes.componentsHint: A percentage of the price for each part of the tax.
taxes.name: Name
taxes.exemptionsHint: A product category taxed at zero, with the reason and its evidence.
taxes.onlyDrafts: Only a draft can be changed. A verified profile is corrected with a new revision.

next.verify: Check the rules, then verify them so they can be used.
next.correct: Rules changed? Make a correction; it replaces this profile once verified.

taxes.verifyText: Check the rates against the evidence. A verified profile can't be changed.
taxes.supersededInfo: A newer revision replaced this profile.
taxes.supersededLink: Open the revision that replaced it

reasons.stale_document: This profile changed since you opened it. We loaded the latest version: check it and try again.
reasons.tax_profile_verified: This profile is verified and can't be changed. Make a correction instead.
reasons.tax_profile_correction_exists: This profile already has a correction.
reasons.tax_profile_overlap: Another verified profile already covers the same country, region, type, category and dates.
